title: Santander's Ana Botin on US Growth, Debt, AI and the Global Economy | The David Rubenstein Show
text: Santander Executive Chair Ana Botin sits down with David Rubenstein to discuss the bank's expansion in the US, including its recent acquisition of Webster Financial, and why she sees lack of economic growth as one of the biggest challenges facing the global economy. She also discusses US debt, the outlook for the US and European economies amid geopolitical uncertainty, and the impact of AI on banking and jobs. Botin is on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This episode was recorded July 13 in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)
